P01: Native direction, same-input virtual G03 full update L2; source weights remain Native
P02: G03 direction, same-input Native full update L2
P03: Tier sample-slot mass M: target tier shares proportional to sqrt(M)
P04: Tier sample-slot mass M: target tier shares proportional to 1/sqrt(M)
P05: Present tiers target shares proportional to fixed physical population 4:3:3
P06: Equal present tiers; average covered repeated physical slots, original dataset mass counted once inside tier
P07: Equal present tiers; equal present profiles inside tier; sample weighted inside tier/profile
P08: G03 only STATIC all-seven common coverage region
P09: G03 only complement of STATIC all-seven common region
P10: G03 except classifier.weight and classifier.bias use Native
single_tier: Source weighting returns Native including P06/P07; P01/P02 global norm controls may still rescale covered single-tier regions
failure: Preserve logs/checkpoints; finish batch peer, then stop later batches. No retry or parameter change.
no_extensions: Exactly P01-P10; no G03/baseline rerun, other seed, scoring, Memory or unplanned combination
